proof_boundaries: Observed wrapper status is measured with final canonical identity checked by the wrapper; this audit independently verifies raw-byte recorded and current source snapshots, not the canonical serializer.
Frame intervals measure process starts; callback timers are elapsed and may include scheduling or driver waits. None measures GPU execution, scanout or input-to-photon latency.

The matrix is sequential Low then Standard with ordinary background load. Final close-Fire runs follow other cases and reuse resident renderer caches; isolated10-second baselines started with empty outline/native surface caches. Differences are not controlled speedup ratios.

Close Fire has12 finite paid casts with no refill. Whole-run averages include the explicitly counted empty-field frames before contact and after expiry;150-region and occupied groups expose that limitation.

Low close Fire mean25.750967ms/p9539.507ms has no interval above50ms in this sample but does not meet sustained60FPS. Far Fire Low has7 intervals above50ms and must not be described as universally smooth.

Per-region normalization uses accepted prepared records; mirror denominator is Conflagration records, nested fire-mark denominator is actual fire-mark calls. Inclusive categories overlap and are never summed as independent CPU costs.

Tick/wall rates are independently recomputed; zero app dropped/clamped counters alone would not prove120Hz wall-clock progress. Cold/travel rows intentionally pause local control and are kept separate.
PNG existence, signature, dimensions and stable bytes are witnesses only; this audit does not add visual inspection, human feel acceptance, multiplayer or exported-package verification.
Full observer retains timing dictionaries and samples, so process memory growth includes the observer. Source snapshots cannot detect edit-then-restore between their endpoints.
